spans.s: भर m. 1. Taking away, theft; 2. burden, weight, किं शेषस्य भर्वयथा न वपुषि क्ष्मां न क्षिपत्येष यत् Mud.ii., Bt.iii.51; 3. a great number, a multitude, विलसद्दशनांशुकेसरभरैः परितः Sis.ix.47, Bh.V.i.54; 4. a bulk, a large quantity; 5. excess, चिंतयामि तदाननं कुटिलभ्रु कोपभरेण Git.G.iii.; 6. a particular measure of weight.

भार m. 1. Load, burden, weight, श्रोणाभारादलसगमना Megh.ii.19, R.ii.18; 2. excess, R.xiv.68; 3. labour, toil, trouble; 4. a large quantity, a mass; 5. a particular weight equal to 2000 palas of gold; 6. a yoke for carrying burden.
भरट m. 1. A potter; 2. a servant.
भरण (I) a. (f. णी) Bearing, supporting, nourishing.
भरण (II) n. 1. The act of nourishing or supporting, R.i.24; 2. the act of carrying; 3. of bringing or procuring; 4. nutriment; 5. hire, wages.
भरण (III) m. The constellation Bharaṇī.
भरण (I) a. (f. णी) Bearing, supporting, nourishing.
भरणी f. Name of the second constellation contaning three stars.
भरणी-भू m. an epithet of Rāhu.
भरंड n. 1. A master, a lord; 2. a king; 3. an ox, a bull.
भारंड m. A species of bird. (Also भारुंड.)
भरण्य n. 1. Cherishing, maintaining; 2. wages, hire; 3. the lunar mansion Bharaṇī.
भरण्या f. Wages, hire.
भरण्य-भुज् m. a hired servant.
भरण्यु m. 1. A master; 2. a protector; 3. a friend; 4. fire; 5. the moon; 6. the sun.

भरत m. 1. Name of the son of Dushyanta by Śakuntalā; (See App. II.); 2. name of an ancient sage, who is said to have founded the science of music and dramaturgy; 3. name of one of the brothers of Rāma; (See App. II.); 4. an actor, a stage-player, कविर्निसर्गसौहृदेन भरतेषु स्वकृतिमेवंप्रायगुणभूयसीमस्माकमर्पितवान् M.M.i.; 5. a hired soldier; 6. a barbarian, a mountaineer.
भारत (I) m. 1. A descendant of Bharata; 2. native of India; 3. an actor.

भारत (II) n. 1. India, the country of Bharata; 2. name of the most popular itihāsa in Sanskrit detailing the history of the descendants of Bharata. Vyāsa is its reputed author, श्रवणांजलिपुटपेयं विरचितवान् भारताख्यममृतं यः । तमहमरागमकृष्णं कृष्णद्वैपायनं वंदे Ve.i.
भरत-अग्रज m. an epithet of Rāma, R.xiv.73.
भरत-खंड n. name of a part of Bhāratavarsha (q.v.).
भरत-ज्ञ a. conversant with the science of dramaturgy.
भरत-पुत्रक m. an actor.
भरत-वर्ष n. the country of Bharata, i.e. India.
भरत-वाक्य n. the final benediction in a play, the final chorus, तदापीदमस्तु भरतवाक्यम् Mud.vii.
भरथ m. 1. A sovereign, a king; 2. fire; 3. a deity presiding over one of the regions of the world.
भरद्वाज m. 1. Name of one of the seven sages; 2. a skylark.
भारद्वाज (I) m. 1. An epithiet of Droṇa, the military preceptor of the Kauravas and Pāṇḍavas; 2. of Agastya; 3. the planet Mars; 4. a sky-lark.
भारद्वाज (II) n. A bone.
भरद्वाज-वाजक m. a sky-lark.
भरित a. (f. ता) 1. Nourished; 2. filled with, full of, दिगंतानातेने कुसुमभरसौरभ्यभरितान् Bh.V.i.33.
भरित a. (f. ता) 1. Nourished; 2. filled with, full of, दिगंतानातेने कुसुमभरसौरभ्यभरितान् Bh.V.i.33.
भरु m. 1. A husband; 2. a name of Śiva; 3. of Viṣṇu; 4. gold; 5. the sea.
भरुज m. (fem. ˚जा or ˚जी) A jackal.
भरुटक n. Fried meat.
भर्ग m. 1. A name of Śiva; 2. of Brahman (m.).
भार्ग m. A king of the Bhargas.
भर्ग्य m. An epithet of Śiva.
भर्जन (I) a. (f. ना) 1. Roasting, baking; 2. annihilating.
भर्जन (II) n. 1. The act of frying or roasting; 2. a frying-pan.
भर्जन (I) a. (f. ना) 1. Roasting, baking; 2. annihilating.

भर्तृ m. 1. A husband, ईप्सितं भर्तृरुपस्थितोदयम् R.iii.1, Megh.ii.36; 2. master, lord, landlord, R.i.74, Megh.i.1, 33; 3. a commander, स्वभर्तृनामग्रहणाद्बभूव सांद्रे रजस्यात्मपरावबोधः R.vii.41; 4. a bearer, a supporter.
भर्तृ-घ्नी f. a woman who murders her husband.
भर्तृ-दारक m. a crown prince, young prince, an heir apparent (a term of address often used in drama).
भर्तृ-दारिका f. a princess (a term of address in drama).
भर्तृ-मती f. married woman whose husband is living.
भर्तृ-व्रत n. fidelity to a husband.
भर्तृ-व्रता f. a virtuous and devoted wife.
भर्तृ-हरि m. name of a celebrated author and grammarian, under whose name pass the three well-known Śatakas.
भर्त्स् vt. 10U (pres. भर्त्सयति-ते; but generally Atm.) 1. To menace, to threaten; 2. to reproach, to abuse; 3. to deride.With निस्-, 1. to censure, to reproach; 2. to put to shame.
भर्त्सक m. A threatener, a reviler.
भर्त्सन n. 1. Threatening, reviling; 2. threat, reproach, abuse; 3. a curse.
भर्त्सना f. 1. Threatening, reviling; 2. threat, reproach, abuse; 3. a curse.
भर्त्सन n. 1. Threatening, reviling; 2. threat, reproach, abuse; 3. a curse.
भर्म n. 1. Wages, hire; 2. gold; 3. the navel.
भर्मण्या f. Wages, hire.
भर्मन् n. 1. Support, maintenance; 2. wages, hire; 3. gold; 4. a gold coin; 5. the navel.
भार-आक्रांत a. overburdened, heavily laden.
भार-उद्वह m. a burden-carrier.
भार-उपजीवन n. earning a livelihood by carrying burdens.
भार-यष्टि f. a peg, a pole for carrying burdens.
भार-वाह् a. (f. भारौही) carrying a load.
भार-वाह् a. (f. भारौही) carrying a load.
भार-वाह m. a burden-carrier.
भार-वाहन (I) m. a beast of burden.
भार-वाहन (II) n. a cart, a waggon.
भार-वाहिक m. a porter.
भार-सह a. very strong or powerful.
भार-हर, -हार m. a burden-bearer.
भार-हर, -हार m. a burden-bearer.
भार-हारिन् m. an epithet of Kṛṣṇa.

भारती f. 1. The goddess of speech; 2. speech, eloquence, literary art, जयति पद्मावतीरमणकविभारती Git.G.x., भारती कवेर्जयति K.Pr.i.; 3. a particular kind of style, (भारती संस्कृतप्रायो वाग्व्यापारो नटाश्रयः D.R.iii.5); 4. a quail.
भारव m. A bowstring.
भारवि m. Name of the author of the Kirātārjunīya, तावद्भा भारवेर्भाति यावन्माघस्य नोदयः । उदिते च पुनर्माघे रवेरिव Ud.
भारि m. A lion.
भारिक (I) a. (f. का) Heavy.
भारिक (I) a. (f. का) Heavy.
भारिक (I) a. (f. का) Heavy.
भारिक (I) a. (f. का) Heavy.
भारिन् (II) m. A burden-bearer, porter.
भार्गव m. 1. Name of Śukra, regent of the planet Venus and preceptor of the demons; 2. an epithet of Paraśurāma; (See App. II.); 3. an epithet of Śiva; 4. an archer.
भार्गव-प्रिय m. a diamond.
भार्गवी f. 1. The Dūrvā grass; 2. an epithet of Lakṣmī.
भार्य m. A servant, a dependent.
भार्या f. 1. A wife lawfully married, R.i.55; 2. the female of an animal.
भार्या-आट a. living by the prostitution of his wife, hen-pecked.
भार्या-ऊढ m. a married man, भार्योढं तमवज्ञाय Bt.iv.15.
भार्यारु m. 1. A kind of deer; 2. an adulterer.
